excluded.title: Lack of two-step process for contract ownership changes
excluded.why: Ownership transfer in one step; a process best practice.

excluded.title: Incorrect application of penalty fee rate
excluded.why: A penalty rate applied to too long a period overcharges borrowers; a calculation bug nobody gains from.

excluded.title: FraxlendPairDeployer cannot deploy contracts of fewer than 13,000 bytes
excluded.why: The pair deployer fails for small contracts; a functional bug.

excluded.title: setCreationCode fails to overwrite _secondHalf slice if updated code size is less than 13,000 bytes
excluded.why: A stale code half after the owner replaces the creation code; an admin-only functional bug.

excluded.title: Risk of invalid batches due to unsafe cast in depart function
excluded.why: An unsafe cast makes an invalid batch only if the trusted captain passes a huge value; the system stops until it is removed.
